exposure: Reason for cesarean section (maternal preference vs. obstetric indications)
cohort: 204 women with a history of both vaginal and cesarean delivery.
finding: Among women who had experienced both vaginal and cesarean deliveries, 63.2% recommended vaginal delivery, primarily due to postpartum comfort, while those recommending cesarean section found it easier due to pain during vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: The majority of women (63.2%) recommended vaginal delivery.
